title: Reverse mode of `pad` raises when only the scalar fill value `padding_value` is differentiated
summary: `jax.grad` of `lax.pad` with respect to the padding value raises a `TypeError`,
and so does `jax.grad` of `jnp.pad` with respect to `constant_values`.
Forward mode works, and so does reverse mode if the operand is differentiated as well.
cause: and `_pad_transpose` returns a cotangent for each linear input:
t_operand = t_op() if ad.is_undefined_primal(operand) else None
t_padv = sub(total(t), total(t_operand)) if ad.is_undefined_primal(padding_value) else None
The cotangent of `padding_value` is the sum of the cotangent `t` over the padding,
computed as the sum of `t` minus the sum of the cotangent of `operand`.
If `operand` is not a linear input, `t_operand` is `None`, and `total(None)` raises in `reduce_sum`.
This is always the case when reverse mode differentiates with respect to `padding_value` alone:
`linear_jvp` instantiates the zero tangent of `operand` as a constant, which is not a linear input.
fix: Compute `t_op()` whenever `padding_value` is a linear input.
lean: `Jax.Lax.padTranspose_correct` proves both cotangents correct where both arguments are linear inputs,
also for negative and interior padding.
`Jax.Lax.padTranspose_not_correct` shows that the rule raises for every padding configuration
where `padding_value` is a linear input and `operand` is not.
reproducer: # One entry before x, one between its entries and two after: five entries are padding.
# So the derivative of the sum in the padding value is 5, as forward mode computes.
# Reverse mode works if x is differentiated too.
print(jax.grad(lambda x, v: lax.pad(x, v, config).sum(), argnums=(0, 1))(x, 0.5)[1])
# Reverse mode in the padding value alone raises.
# actual:  TypeError: Error interpreting argument to reduce_sum as a JAX value. The problematic value is of type <class 'NoneType'> and was passed to reduce_sum at position 0.
# jnp.pad pads with lax.pad, so its gradient in constant_values raises too.
# actual:  TypeError: Error interpreting argument to reduce_sum as a JAX value. The problematic value is of type <class 'NoneType'> and was passed to reduce_sum at position 0.
